name: search_code_ok
description: repo_search must answer with ok:true whenever a search runs, independent of how many matches a query returns — whether rg produces results or the host-side literal search falls back. This pins the exec/policy/serialization path without depending on any specific query outcome, so it stays green on any machine and goes red when the exec_allow policy or the JSON serialization breaks.
prompt: Use the repo_search tool with {"engine":"rg","query":"fn main","path":"."}. Look at the tool's JSON result and reply with only the value of its "ok" field: true or false.
